title: Karabiner-Elements complex modification rule
description: Schema for a Karabiner-Elements complex_modifications asset file (~/.config/karabiner/assets/complex_modifications/*.json), a single rule, or a single manipulator. Derived from pqrs-org/pqrs.org docs and pqrs-org/Karabiner-Elements source (parser key sets, parameter defaults, and the simple_modifications.json key-code tables).

complexModificationsFile.description: A custom *.json file placed in ~/.config/karabiner/assets/complex_modifications/. Unknown keys are permitted here and at rule level (Karabiner ignores them, and generators add their own metadata); strictness applies inside `manipulators`.

title.description: Shown as the group heading in Settings.

maintainer.description: Non-standard singular form seen in the wild.

complexModifications.description: The complex_modifications block of a profile, or of a generator's build output.

karabinerConfig.description: ~/.config/karabiner/karabiner.json. Permissive outside complex_modifications: devices, virtual_hid_keyboard, fn_function_keys and simple_modifications are passed through unvalidated because they are not covered by the rule documentation.

description.description: Shown in Settings; keep it unique and human-readable.

enabled.description: Ignored by the parser; used by some third-party generators.

manipulator.description: Evaluated top to bottom; the FIRST matching manipulator wins and the rest are skipped.

to_if_alone.description: Posted when `from` is pressed and released alone. key_down and key_up are sent together, so key repeat is impossible here.

to_if_other_key_pressed.description: Rewrites the held `from` key itself when one of other_keys is pressed.

manipulatorMouseBasic.description: Invert, swap, or discard mouse movement. Requires the mouse to be enabled in the Devices tab.

discard.description: DANGER: always pair discard with a device_if condition or the cursor can become unmovable.

manipulatorMouseMotionToScroll.description: Converts pointer motion into scrolling. Specify from.modifiers or conditions, or the mouse becomes unusable.

fromModifiers.description: mandatory modifiers are consumed (removed from `to`); optional modifiers are passed through. Without "optional": ["any"], the manipulator will not fire when extra modifiers are held.

mandatory.description: Modifiers that must be held; removed from the output events.

optional.description: Modifiers allowed to be held; kept in the output events.

detect_key_down_uninterruptedly.description: If true, an unrelated key_down between the target keys does not cancel the match.

key_up_order.description: Ignored once basic.simultaneous_threshold_milliseconds elapses; raise that parameter when using this.

to_after_key_up.description: Posted once every `from` event is released; typical place to clear mode variables.

key_code.description: Must be a key_code name (see EventViewer, or karabiner-keycodes.json) or a raw usage integer.

consumer_key_code.description: Must be a consumer_key_code (media key) name or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code name (mission_control, launchpad, ...) or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_top_case_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_top_case_key_code name (brightness_*, illumination_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

generic_desktop.description: Must be a generic_desktop usage name (system_sleep, dpad_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

pointing_button.description: Must be a pointing_button name (button1 = left click) or a raw usage integer.

any.description: Match every event of this type. DANGER: "pointing_button" can cost you the left click.

integer_value.description: Match only events carrying this integer value (multi-button footpedals etc.).

key_code.description: Must be a key_code name (see EventViewer, or karabiner-keycodes.json) or a raw usage integer.

consumer_key_code.description: Must be a consumer_key_code (media key) name or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code name (mission_control, launchpad, ...) or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_top_case_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_top_case_key_code name (brightness_*, illumination_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

generic_desktop.description: Must be a generic_desktop usage name (system_sleep, dpad_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

pointing_button.description: Must be a pointing_button name (button1 = left click) or a raw usage integer.

simultaneous.description: Keys pressed together within basic.simultaneous_threshold_milliseconds (default 50 ms).

fromEventDefinition.description: Exactly one of key_code / consumer_key_code / apple_vendor_* / generic_desktop / pointing_button / any / simultaneous.

value.description: Types are not coerced: 1 != true, true != "true". Unset variables read as 0.

mouseKey.description: Speeds and directions follow System Settings > Mouse.

vertical_wheel.description: Negative = scroll up, positive = scroll down.

horizontal_wheel.description: Positive = scroll left, negative = scroll right.

speed_multiplier.description: Multiplies mouse-key speed while this key is held.

softwareFunction.description: KE 13.5.1+. Exactly one function per `to` entry.

cg_event_double_click.description: Laggy (software-generated) and needs Accessibility permission for karabiner_console_user_server; two pointing_button events are usually better.

frontmost_application_history_index.description: Priority 3 (KE 15.3.6+). Only apps launched after KE started and still running are candidates.

open_application.description: When several of bundle_identifier / file_path / history_index are given, only the highest-priority one is used.

relative_to.description: Source-only (not yet in the published docs).

fallback_to.description: Source-only; used when relative_to target is unavailable.

key_code.description: Must be a key_code name (see EventViewer, or karabiner-keycodes.json) or a raw usage integer.

consumer_key_code.description: Must be a consumer_key_code (media key) name or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_keyboard_key_code name (mission_control, launchpad, ...) or a raw usage integer.

apple_vendor_top_case_key_code.description: Must be an apple_vendor_top_case_key_code name (brightness_*, illumination_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

generic_desktop.description: Must be a generic_desktop usage name (system_sleep, dpad_*, ...) or a raw usage integer.

pointing_button.description: Must be a pointing_button name (button1 = left click) or a raw usage integer.

from_event.description: Re-send the `from` event verbatim. With from.any this builds pass-through mode: once an event is modified it is exempt from later rules.

shell_command.description: Runs with a minimal environment ($HOME, $UID, $USER, ...). Export LC_ALL etc. inside the command when needed.

payload.description: JSON-serialized and sent to the receiver.

select_input_source.description: CJKV input sources with input_mode_id may fail to switch (macOS issue); send the OS shortcut instead.

anyOf.description: Regex specifiers; multiple keys within one object are ANDed.

items.description: Regex specifiers; multiple keys within one object are ANDed.

id.description: Unique id; reuse it to update or clear the message.

text.description: Empty string removes the message. Always clear what you set.

sticky_modifier.description: Exactly one modifier per entry; repeat the entry for multiple sticky modifiers.

modifiers.description: Modifiers posted with the event. Here command/control/option/shift are aliases of the LEFT variants (in `from` they mean either side). "any" parses but adds no flag.

lazy.description: Modifier is not sent until another key is pressed with it.

repeat.description: false suppresses key repeat and sends key_down+key_up at press time.

halt.description: In to_if_alone / to_if_held_down: cancel to_after_key_up and to_delayed_action.

hold_down_milliseconds.description: Gap between key_down and key_up when both are sent at once (caps_lock needs ~200).

held_down_milliseconds.description: Undocumented alias of hold_down_milliseconds accepted by the parser.

conditions.description: KE 15.3.7+. Evaluated once, before the first event of the `to` array is processed.

toEventDefinition.description: Exactly one event key per entry (key_code, shell_command, set_variable, software_function, ...).

to.description: Must be an array here; the single-object shorthand is not accepted by this parser.

to_if_invoked.description: Sent when no other key was pressed before the delay elapsed.

to_if_canceled.description: Sent when another key was pressed first.

parameters.description: Valid at profile complex_modifications level and per-manipulator. Out-of-range values are clamped with a log warning, not rejected.

basic.to_if_alone_timeout_milliseconds.description: Holding longer than this cancels to_if_alone.

mouse_motion_to_scroll.speed.description: Percent; the runtime divides by 100. Profile-level parameter.

type.description: device_exists_* (KE 14.8.4+) test connection, not event origin.

identifiers.description: Entries are ORed; keys inside one entry are ANDed.

location_id.description: Changes when the USB port changes.

device_address.description: Bluetooth MAC (KE 14.12.2+); changes with hardware replacement.

keyboard_types.description: ORed. Refers to the VIRTUAL keyboard type, not the physical device.

items.description: Regex specifiers; multiple keys within one object are ANDed.

input_sources.description: Entries are ORed; keys inside one entry are ANDed.

value.description: Strict type match: 1 != true, true != "true". Unset variables evaluate as 0.

expression.description: exprtk syntax. Undefined variables are 0. system.* and accessibility.* variables are available.
